title: Observability carousel: compact dashboard screenshots + annotated micro-flows for onboarding
creator: Ava Moreno
description: Create a compact set of annotated dashboard screenshots and a 3-card carousel flow for the onboarding quickstart. Focus areas: latency distribution view, cost-per-token breakdown, and a trace drilling micro-flow. Assets must be usable as: in-app onboarding carousel, docs hero images, and a one-page quickstart PDF. Keep visuals lightweight (PNG + low-res SVG variants) and ensure text annotations match console copy. Avoid duplicating existing quickstart artwork; prioritize compact compositions that fit mobile and narrow-surface hero slots.
acceptance_criteria: Three carousel cards exported at required sizes (desktop hero, mobile hero, docs thumbnail)
Each card includes short caption copy consistent with console tone-of-voice
Annotations point to latency P95, cost-per-token, and sample trace span; annotation copy reviewed by PM and RE team
Files uploaded to Drive and referenced in PR; design tokens and fonts match console spec
Assets accessible (alt text supplied) and labeled for localization
design_notes: Trade-offs: to fit mobile hero width we compress legend into inline callouts; kept color palette aligned to observability theme but increased contrast for small thumbnails. Chose simplified histogram (bins=20) to avoid visual noise when scaled down. For cost-per-token chart used sparkline + numeric delta instead of full table to reduce visual weight. Trace micro-flow highlights three spans (api.receive -> runtime.generate -> cache.hit) to show latency hotspots without exposing internal topology. Will include callouts for fallback routing and batching where relevant.

notes_for_engineering: When implementing, use SVG microflow for responsive scaling. Expose token cost delta number as a data attribute for accessibility. Ensure charts use the console theme tokens (token-color-chart-1..3). Do not hard-code internal service names in trace labels; use 'API', 'Runtime', 'Cache' instead.
localization_requirements: Short caption copy must be <= 90 characters. Provide alt text and context strings for translators. Avoid idioms and acronyms in captions.
